questions.question: What is the annual leave allowance for full-time employees?
questions.expected_answer: Employees receive 25 annual leave days.

questions.question: How many paid sick leave days do employees get?
questions.expected_answer: Sick leave is capped at 10 paid days per year.

questions.question: What are the office hours at NexusAI?
questions.expected_answer: NexusAI office hours are from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

questions.question: What is the dress code?
questions.expected_answer: Dress code is smart casual.

questions.question: How much is the Standard HMO deductible?
questions.expected_answer: Standard HMO has a deductible of 500 dollars per individual.

questions.question: What is the monthly gym reimbursement benefit?
questions.expected_answer: Employees can claim up to 75 dollars per month for gym membership reimbursement.

questions.question: What is the lodging reimbursement cap per night?
questions.expected_answer: Lodging reimbursement is capped at 200 dollars per night.

questions.question: How often must passwords be rotated?
questions.expected_answer: Passwords must be rotated every 90 days.

questions.question: Where should suspicious phishing emails be forwarded?
questions.expected_answer: Suspicious emails must be forwarded to security@nexusai.com.

questions.question: Within how many minutes will IT isolate systems in a security incident?
questions.expected_answer: IT will verify and isolate systems within 15 minutes.

questions.question: What are the flex-time hours and attendance log rules?
questions.expected_answer: Flex-time allows starting between 7:30 AM and 10:00 AM, and attendance logs must be signed weekly.

questions.question: What is the parental leave duration and who qualifies?
questions.expected_answer: Parental leave is 12 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers.

questions.question: What is the hybrid remote work allowance and monthly stipend?
questions.expected_answer: Employees can work remotely up to 2 days per week, and the home office stipend is 50 dollars per month.

questions.question: What is the wellness program checkup bonus and gym reimbursement cap?
questions.expected_answer: Checkups reward with a 100 dollar annual bonus, and gym reimbursement is up to 75 dollars per month.

questions.question: What is the 401k match percentage and the vesting period?
questions.expected_answer: NexusAI matches 100% of contributions up to 4% of salary, and the vesting period is 2 years.

questions.question: What are the password complexity requirements for character count and MFA?
questions.expected_answer: Passwords must be at least 12 characters, and Multi-Factor Authentication is mandatory.

questions.question: What are the three data classifications and rules for client data?
questions.expected_answer: Data is classified as Public, Internal, or Confidential. Client personal data access is restricted to a need-to-know basis.

questions.question: What are the home office bandwidth requirements and password rotation cycles?
questions.expected_answer: Required bandwidth is 50 Mbps download, and passwords must be rotated every 90 days.

questions.question: What is the annual leave allowance and the 401k vesting period?
questions.expected_answer: Annual leave is 25 days, and the 401k vesting period is 2 years.

questions.question: What are the receipt requirements for travel reimbursement and password length rules?
questions.expected_answer: Reimbursement requires receipts for expenses above 25 dollars, and passwords must be at least 12 characters.

questions.question: What is the hybrid remote work policy and standard HMO deductible?
questions.expected_answer: Remote work is allowed up to 2 days per week, and Standard HMO deductible is 500 dollars.

questions.question: How do flex-time schedules relate to password complexity policies?
questions.expected_answer: Flex-time allows starting from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM, and password length must be at least 12 characters.

questions.question: What is the gym reimbursement cap and incident response isolation time?
questions.expected_answer: Reimbursement is up to 75 dollars per month, and incident isolation takes 15 minutes.
